rationale: The condition establishes whether suitably qualified reference inputs exist to instantiate the mapped procedure. Surveying holdings and verifying their ordering, comparability and dating basis checks ordinary input requirements; failure prevents running the otherwise coherent bisection procedure.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Survey dated holdings for the creator and context, identify comparable correspondence, and document a secure chronological ordering with each reference date’s independent basis and precision. Verify that dates constrain writing dates rather than assuming postmarks or accession dates suffice.
